title: Headless TTW Operation: Anchorage! (DLC02OA4): from the Command Tent with Sergeant Montgomery across the pulse field to its switch, into the Chinese compound and General Jingwei, General Chase's debriefing and out of the simulation to the Outcast base's armory (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script] Then Paving the Way done (the given, as ttw-dlc02oa3-paving-the-way leaves it): its strike team deployed and a loadout taken (DLC02StrikeTeam: StHaveReq 1 from the Requisition Terminal, StDeployGo 1 from Patterson's Sure entry, made -1 by DLC02StrikeTeam's script once the team is placed [observed: SCPT 0x0B002D0B]), without which the Command Tent's door (DLC02OA3CommandTentDoor's script [observed]) shows its refusal and does not open; the player is back in the simulation's Command Tent with the Chimera Depot and the Listening Post taken; DLC02OA3 200's stage script set DLC02OA4 10 (Disable the Pulse Field).
Sergeant Montgomery goes with the player to the Pulse Field (his greeting's end script: BenjiFollow 1).

actions.label: montgomery: let's go take down the pulse field

actions.text: Travel stand-in: across the pulse-mine field to its bunker. The player throws the bunker's switch (DLC02MinefieldSwitchScript [observed]: the field's mines off, SwitchThrown 1); 4 seconds on Montgomery calls in the T-51b troops and DLC02OA4QuestScript sets stage 20 (Enter the Chinese Compound).

Travel stand-in: behind the T-51b troops to the Chinese headquarters. Its door (TTW's DLC02ChineseHQDoorScript [observed]) enables General Jingwei as the player goes through; inside, the player steps into the end battle's trigger (DLC02EndBattleTriggerScript [observed]: stage 30, Kill General Jingwei, and Jingwei's package re-evaluated).
Stand-in for the sword fight with General Jingwei: the player kills him (DLC02GeneralJingweiScript's OnDeath [observed]: stage 40).

actions.label: milestone: DLC02OA4 40, report to General Chase

actions.text: Stage 40's script moves General Chase into the compound; his debriefing ends the simulation (DLC02OA4ChaseGreet1's end script: ChaseDone 1, MoveTimer 3, stage 50).

DLC02OA4QuestScript [observed], 3 seconds on, empties the player's simulation inventory and puts the player back at the pod (DLC02SimChairREF) in the Outcast base; there it sets stage 60 (Access the VSS Armory, with Power Armor Training).

actions.label: player back in the Outcast base
mcgraw: good job making it through

actions.text: The armory's Secure Access Terminal: its entry that opens the armory (DLC02VSSSecureAccessTerminal item 1 [observed]) unlocks DLC02RewardDoor, EndStep 2 and objective 70. Walking in through the door (DLC02OA4EndStep3Trigger) sets stage 200.
